pins.main_and_scientific_source_difference: Two entry Markdown files changed; frozen scientific input/code checks use the original source pin. No claim that a current moving main still has this snapshot.

layout.all_ZIPs: Unpack all companion ZIPs into the same parent; retain the single work_personnel_typing_A_20261019 prefix and recovered sibling layout.

Pro_exact_fixed_background_v1.uses: Training relations and nested K/model selection only in that fold training buildings; outer evaluation allowed after exclusion. v1 in panel name is the request-design label; data remain v2.

A_nested_even_v1.uses: Frozen-type evaluation on extra backgrounds and supported k=8/12/16/24 nodes only; no type/K selection.

evidence.format: gzip JSON object; top-level records array
evidence.qualification: quality_usable, condition, quality_use, point/ring/reference and review gates inherited; non-qualified Q is missing, not zero

folds.full: FULL means descriptive all-building fit; not test predictions
folds.train_groups: Each outer training building list has three frozen hash-partition inner validation groups. Refit features, transforms, relationships and type choice on each inner training subset.
folds.no_room_closure: Direct physical_same-support groups only; no transitive closure or shared-building surrogate for same room.

fields.worker_id: anonymous person identity; inventory has 62, Q profiles 60
fields.heldout_building: actual heldout building; null in descriptive source FULL mapped to literal FULL
fields.fold_id: same outer fold context; FULL descriptive only
fields.method_id: model alias; source_candidate_id/candidate_method gives the training-chosen candidate
fields.difficulty: canonical global/easy/medium/hard; source all maps to global; Chinese maps to English label only
fields.class_id: arbitrary within-fold label; unknown means unsupported; do not match C01 across folds
fields.n_images/n_buildings: historical person support; forward core_images/core_buildings map here
fields.train_key/training_key: history subset identity; encodings differ by route, compare actual frozen building lists
fields.unknown_reason: support/feature gate reason; not an error or quality judgment

person_classes.cross_fold_alignment: Use pair coassignment or ARI; numeric class IDs are not globally aligned.

fields.theta_easy/theta_medium/theta_hard: training-only difficulty partial-pooling effects, support gate applied
fields.theta_*_estimate: estimate retained even if insufficient for a difficulty type; do not erase support gate
fields.q_abs_*: absolute delivery distribution within the ordinary Manual Q layer
fields.t_source_origin_effect: same-task relative log source time separately adjusted by old/new provenance
fields.source_time_*: eligible Manual source-task time pool; Q qualification is separate
fields.target_time_*: same-target time only; never substituted by source time
fields.semi_old_*: old confirmed error opportunities / edit history
fields.semi_new_*: new reported error opportunities / edit history, not confirmed repair
fields.scope_gold_n: limited in-scope compatible opportunities; not general scope gold
fields.individual_review_records/specific_error: documentary audit/exclusion ledger, not representative per-person error rates

historical_features.missingness: Actual missing cells retained; support flags explicit; no zero-quality or zero-error imputation.

fields.historical_dissimilarity: forward multi-domain history distance, with common_domain_names and per-domain distances
fields.same9_observed/same12_observed: training-image local-cluster co-membership, then image/building aggregation
fields.*_posterior: training-only shrunk relation estimate, not a target-image cluster
fields.n_swap_images/n_swap_buildings: support for replacement relationship separately from geometry support

historical_person_pairs.local_cluster_ids: Valid only within their image; not a cross-image person class.

fields.event_id: same immutable event identifier for all methods
fields.worker_a/worker_b: lexicographic entrant orientation a<b; signed outcome is B minus A
fields.background_members: same k-1 actual workers both sides, pipe-separated
fields.background_order: saved actual background order; distinct from unordered member set
fields.ordered_workers_a/ordered_workers_b: saved request order; frozen fusion applies its native worker ordering
fields.chain_id: canonical raw-event fixed-pair nested-background identity; empty for old panel
fields.nested_chain_id: assessment alias copied directly from event chain_id; no hashing, inference or reconstruction from k
fields.reference_id/reference_version: fixed pool reference; never optimize by output score
fields.k: actual equal total team size at both endpoints

fields.D10_*: fixed-members measurement sensitivity, direction scale 8 to 10 degrees only
fields.floor_jaccard_difference/floor_change: output-to-output floor change; separate from each output to GT IoU
fields.structure_bound_cyclic_deg: shared binding/cycle angular comparison; does not optimize top/bottom separately
fields.upper_bound_shift_*/lower_bound_shift_*: upper/lower diagnostics under the same native paired cyclic correspondence
fields.both_complete: native full geometry computable at both endpoints; not new human acceptance
fields.source_time_*: source-audited/reported sums and missingness per team

predictions.long_probability: probability; reverse predicted_stability is an alias
predictions.training: Only old main panel in all buildings except target; calibration recomputed independently by assessment from frozen class labels
predictions.calibrator: k×difficulty, image then building equal, two equivalent-building prior; unknown gets the cell/k/global baseline
predictions.new_panel: Never used for category count or parameter selection

last_seat_policy.fields: choose_a_probability__<policy> gives probability of choosing endpoint A under frozen historical policy; ties/random use expected endpoint outcome
last_seat_policy.scope: A single contested seat with fixed k-1 background; not a full-team global optimum or extra collected human sample

sensitivity.fixed_members_metric: Same endpoint team, score with B8 vs D10
sensitivity.history_repartition: Fixed B8-selected family/K, D10 historical Q gives a new partition; no heldout-K reselection
sensitivity.rule: Frozen training-feature explanation rules, with rule coverage separate from original discovered class coverage

final_diagnostics.scope: Post-frozen-class diagnostics; no class, K, threshold or difficulty selection.
final_diagnostics.origin_calibration: Training primary panel only, target building held out; cell k x frozen difficulty x old-old/new-new/old-new; original-function parity <1e-12 on first fold.
final_diagnostics.unit_summary: Event, image and building summaries remain separate; positive brier_improvement means lower squared probability error under the first named method.
final_diagnostics.policy_comparison: Same event, difference in probability of choosing entrant A times the difference in observed endpoint outcomes. Costs retain source-time missingness.

combined_report_tables.person_class_scope: FULL descriptive classes joined to old labels and fold-perturbation classmate stability; not OOF predictions or formal personnel tiers.

four_node_scope.chain_id: nested_chain_id is the original events.chain_id copied without changes
four_node_scope.sequence_claim: Four observed k nodes with shared replacement identity and nested backgrounds; not a complete adjacent-count curve.

combined_report_tables.ablation: All on identical events and B8-selected main K; no heldout reselection; full_gain = Brier(ablated) - Brier(full).

design_support.denominator: Keep every registered event, separately count unique actual endpoint pairs.

reverse_readable_exchange.interpretation: FULL is descriptive; rule feature split usage is not incremental or causal evidence.

joint_stability_reference.not_exhaustive: Keep signed/absolute quality, local/structural changes, raw connection changes and failure separately; no p-value non-significance as equivalence.

missing_and_denominators.failure: Every attempted event remains in denominator; any failed endpoint makes joint stable False. Missing score/geometry/time component remains null, not zero.
missing_and_denominators.unknown_person_class: Preserve all-attempt predictions with baseline fallback; separately report own-supported and common-supported sets. Unknown is not a shared behavioral class.
missing_and_denominators.old_QTD: archive labels including sparse children are separate from old_QTD_supported where unknown/sparse_child are unknown.
missing_and_denominators.source_vs_target_time: No substitution, no lead time, no zero fill. Known sum and known count do not equal complete total cost.
missing_and_denominators.scope: 9845 responses may describe tendency; 93 compatible gold, 89 in quality-person set, all limited in-scope correct; cannot estimate general false-accept rate.
missing_and_denominators.semi: Old confirmed156/nonmodified25; new reported284/45 separate. 60 Q-person subset old144/20; no Q profiles for W019/W026. New525 lack per-record initialization; editing or final score increase is not confirmed correction.
missing_and_denominators.review: Directed review does not estimate global error prevalence. Personal exclusion, GT issue, scene limitation and reference missingness remain separate.
missing_and_denominators.replicates: 286666 registered events are not 286666 independent humans; 49 new-panel duplicated actual endpoint pairs add no independent support.
missing_and_denominators.inference: Main uncertainty at building level; image and event weights separately. Background/panel/k repetitions are dependent.

boolean_csv: Parse True/False explicitly; Python bool("False") is True and must not be used.

leakage_boundary.allowed_history: Frozen training records and references, training-building actual clusters and events, training-only normalization/support and model selection
leakage_boundary.forbidden_for_prospective_test_person_ty: Target building actual Q, point count, local cluster, votes, final geometry or replacement outcomes
leakage_boundary.retrospective_status: Building-excluded retrospective validation on previously explored v2, not a new external blind test

not_reproduced: entire original data collection/log extraction/human audit process
the full omitted historical Pro archive payload byte-for-byte
complete Dot DESIGN, all integer-k curves and team states
visual review of absent original images
